title: BGT 4X4
tickerText: BGT4X4 IS AN AUSSIE-OWNED 4X4 GEAR SPECIALIST BUILT AROUND ONE SIMPLE IDEA: SELL GEAR THAT ACTUALLY WORKS. RUN BY HUSBAND-AND-WIFE TEAM DEWALD AND NICOLE, BGT4X4 FOCUSES ON PRACTICAL UPGRADES FOR MITSUBISHI PAJERO, PAJERO SPORT, TRITON AND CHERY TIGGO OWNERS. THE DIFFERENCE IS HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE — PRODUCTS ARE FITTED, TESTED AND USED ON THEIR OWN VEHICLES BEFORE THEY EARN A PLACE IN THE RANGE. FROM LIGHTING, INTERIOR UPGRADES AND SUSPENSION TO COOLING, PERFORMANCE, BULL BARS AND TOURING GEAR, THE CATALOGUE IS BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO ACTUALLY USE THEIR 4X4S. WITH A BRISBANE WAREHOUSE, QUICK DISPATCH, THOUSANDS OF AUSTRALIAN ORDERS AND A REPUTATION FOR STRAIGHTFORWARD SUPPORT, BGT4X4 IS LESS ABOUT FLASHY CLAIMS AND MORE ABOUT THE RIGHT PART, THE RIGHT FIT AND GEAR YOU CAN TRUST.
